items.title: Google Has Two New Weapons in Its Fight Against Nvidia - Gizmodo
items.summary: # Google Has Two New Weapons in Its Fight Against Nvidia. The company unveiled two new variants of its existing AI chip systems as it ramps up competition with Nvidia. The tech giant announced Monday two new versions of its existing AI chip systems, designed to offer stronger security and handle more demanding AI workloads. The news comes just days after Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, whose company dominates the AI chip market, admitted to having an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. Today, they’re used to train and run Google’s Gemini AI models, power its Google Cloud business, and as of recently being sold to customers for use in their own data centers. Google Chief Technologist and Senior Vice President of AI and Infrastructure Amin Vahdat wrote in a blog post Monday that the two newest systems were designed in part based on feedback from outside customers about their specific needs.
